Shared-element container morph

I wanted to know if one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas can melt any of four live HTML grid cards into an expanded detail sheet and back into its slot. Tap a card to open it, or scrub Morph.

Show the code sdRoundBox SDF morph shader, spring bounds, ElementGL paint and hit-test handoff
  1. Two drawable subtrees in one canvas. The 2×2 grid #mc-grid and expanded sheet #mc-detail sit inside one <canvas content="drawable" layoutsubtree>, with inert hiding whichever subtree is inactive.
  2. Continuous SDF container mask and cross-blur UV scaling. Evaluates sdRoundBox() from the clicked card bounds to the expanded sheet, scales UVs from the originating slot sub-rectangle to #mc-detail, and adds a Gaussian cross-blur plus ambient drop shadow.
  3. Deterministic spring interpolation and box bounds. Integrates morph progress with stepMorphSpring() using elapsed tMs and playback speed, or snaps to target when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active.
  4. Gated single-context paint and geometry sync. Gates stage.upload() on hasPainted inside paint after stage.begin(), and updates updateElementGeometry() with cached geometryUnit() plus dataset.hitTick.
  5. Five-argument 2D clip-morph and plain-HTML fallbacks. Clips a rounded rectangle with 5-argument drawElementImage() when WebGL 2 is absent, and moves both subtrees into #plain-host on context loss.

How it works

Both the 2×2 card grid (#mc-grid) and the expanded detail sheet (#mc-detail) live inside one <canvas content="drawable" layoutsubtree> backed by one ElementGL WebGL 2 context from /lib/element-gl.js. Inside the paint listener, I set hasPainted = true, call stage.begin() first, and then upload whichever subtree changed through gl.texElementSubImage2D() with UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL set to true.

When you tap a card, openCard() copies that slot's theme, counters and saved note into #mc-detail and drives a spring via stepMorphSpring(). The fragment shader measures the clicked card's sub-rectangle inside #mc-grid, interpolates the container centre, size and corner radius from 14 px to 20 px, casts an expanding ambient shadow over a dimmed grid scrim, and evaluates sdRoundBox() while cross-blurring and scaling UV coordinates between the slot texture and #mc-detail. Blur reaches zero at both endpoints so settled text and controls stay crisp.

Because texture shaders don't move Chromium's hit boxes, syncGeometry() calibrates geometryUnit() once per resize on #mc-grid, toggles inert between #mc-grid and #mc-detail across the midpoint, calls canvas.updateElementGeometry(), and flips dataset.hitTick to clear the hit-test cache. An IntersectionObserver and visibilitychange listener pause animation off screen or in hidden tabs, ?route=2d draws a rounded-rect clip morph with 5-argument drawElementImage(), and ?route=plain or webglcontextlost moves both subtrees into #plain-host.

Live checks

These checks run on isolated fixtures on the test stage and leave the demo above untouched. Tap the button below to run them in this browser.

Findings

  • Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27) at 412×915 (2.625 DPR) and 1024×900 (1 DPR): one ElementGL canvas uploads both #mc-grid and #mc-detail via texElementSubImage2D() with gl.getError() === 0, runs at 1.04 MP (8.3 MB live, 0 lost contexts, 0 open snapshots, 0 unasked readbacks), and keeps scrollWidth === 412 and load CLS at 0.
  • Sampling uTex inside the selected slot rectangle with 9 discrete taps produced visible text echoes at 35% morph. Generating mipmaps (gl.generateMipmap() with LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR) and switching to 16 golden-angle Gaussian textureLod() taps (peaking at 7.5 px mid-morph and dropping to LOD 0 at both endpoints) melts the card into the sheet cleanly while keeping settled text sharp.
  • Syncing inert and updateElementGeometry() with a cached geometryUnit() calibrated once on #mc-grid (plus dataset.hitTick toggles) keeps card buttons clickable at 0%, moves focus cleanly across the 50% threshold, and routes clicks to #mc-detail action pills, #mc-note-input and Collapse at 100%.
  • All 6 live checks passed in Chrome 160 Canary under WebGL 2 and under ?route=2d (5-argument drawElementImage() rounded-rect clip morph with draws.wrong === 0), and disabling the API moved both subtrees into #plain-host with working card expansion and note input.
  • Not verified on real hardware: Chrome 159 on Android (412 px wide, 2.625 DPR touch morph feel, soft keyboard focus on #mc-note-input, real GPU frame rate) and npm run check:jank -- /morph-container/ (Playwright isn't installed here).
